about_the_game:
Add to your Wishlist!

The game is still in development, but you can help us a lot by adding it to your Steam Wishlist! You'll be notified as soon as Vicky is ready to start her adventure.

A spell has hidden ten days of history!

Vicky falls asleep peacefully on the evening of October 4th, 1582. However, upon waking, something has changed: the air feels different, and the calendar already reads October 15th!

In Vicky the Fox and the Lost Days, you play as a curious and brave fox on a journey through enchanted worlds to solve a mystery that actually happened (sort of!). Time has taken a magical leap, and the missing days have been hidden inside 22 beautiful Animal Cards.

Literally jump into the adventure and help Vicky restore harmony to the Great Animal Calendar!

Gameplay that changes with you

Accompanied by a mysterious (and very funny) ninja assistant, Vicky will explore fantastic realms and make friends with forest spirits.
Every animal you meet will give you a special Card that unlocks a unique new ability:

  • The Dancing Robins will grant you a double jump to reach the highest platforms.
  • The Traveling Whale will allow you to breathe underwater to explore the ocean depths without rushing.
  • The Radiant Chick will teach you to glide gently using air currents.
  • The Explorer Hedgehog will help you light up the darkest caves with his lantern.

With 22 powers to discover, you can return to areas you've already visited to find new secrets!

Not your "usual" static Platformer

Be prepared for anything! This journey will take you from the depths of the ocean to above the clouds.
You will explore night levels lit only by your lantern, slide on fresh snow, and even take command of an airplane to fly through the clouds!

Key Features

  • 🦊 A Gentle, Non-Violent World: The "Muddlers" aren't bad enemies, just creatures lost in time chaos! No need to fight: a gentle hop on their head will help them calm down.
  • ☕ No Game Over, just Naps: Vicky is tireless, but she needs her coffee cups to stay awake! If the Muddlers touch her, she loses cups. And if they run out? No fear! A soft pillow appears, and Vicky simply takes a nap to recharge and restart the level.
  • 🍇 Collect and Solve: Gather shiny bunches of grapes scattered throughout the levels. They aren't just a delicious snack; they contain puzzle pieces needed to reveal the final mystery of the calendar.
  • 🪶 Find Your Path: Every level hides a precious Colored Feather. Only by finding it can you open the passage to the next realm.
  • 📖 Wisdom to Collect: Talk to the animals! Each one has a story and a lesson of wisdom to share on themes like courage, friendship, and patience.
  • 🌎 Translated into 9 Languages: A borderless adventure, enjoyable by players all over the world.

Perfect for the whole family

With graphics inspired by beloved animated films and a serene atmosphere, Vicky the Fox is designed to stimulate curiosity and problem-solving. It's a sweet challenge for the little ones and a relaxing "comfort game" for adults wanting a break from the daily rush.

About Us

We are Nine Lives Interactive, a small indie team working on our first game! We love nature, animals, and stories that leave a smile. We've poured our hearts into this project.

Have questions, suggestions, or just want to say hi? Join our Discord or follow us on Instagram! We love chatting with players and hearing your ideas as we complete development.

short_description: What happened to the missing days? Join Vicky the Fox in a magical, non-violent platformer! Unlock 22 powers by talking to animals, collect Feathers and Grapes, and solve the calendar mystery. A sweet adventure for the whole family. Add it to your Wishlist!
